title: Define legacy decision-build coverage
summary: Turn legacy rowless decision-build warning debt into explicit deferral or archive/catalog coverage without unsafe artifact mutation.

goal.outcome: Legacy rowless decision-build warnings have explicit residual coverage/deferral or a validated archive/catalog plan with restore evidence requirements.
acceptance: Docs or build evidence explains why pre-DecisionTableV1 rowless decision builds remain warnings until archive/catalog cleanup.
Each legacy-decision-build warning class is covered by accepted deferral/trigger or scoped archival follow-up.
No legacy build is deleted or rewritten without archive SHA/tree SHA and restore ledger evidence.
non_goals: Do not backfill all legacy decision rows by hand.
Do not purge hot artifacts unless GC policy and restore evidence are validated.
verification: wiki_gc action=dry-run if archival candidates are proposed
